name: Event Monster
author: A WP Life

sections.description:
Event Monster helps you create, organize, and display events on your WordPress site. Whether you’re running conferences, workshops, community meetups, or corporate gatherings, this plugin gives you tools for scheduling, attendee registration, and calendar displays.

The admin interface makes it easy to set up occasions in minutes. Add details like date, time, location, description, speakers, sponsors, and more. Visitors can view activities through an interactive calendar or browse a card-based listing with search and category filters.

Pro Demo Links

Check Pro Demo: Event Monster Premium
More About Pro: Event Monster Premium Details
Where To Buy: Buy Event Monster Premium

What You Can Do

Create Events Quickly
Set up unlimited occasions with all the details your attendees need. Include schedules, speaker information, sponsor logos, and photo galleries. Each listing gets its own dedicated page where visitors can learn everything about it.

Display an Interactive Calendar
Show your schedule in a calendar format that visitors can explore. Switch between month, week, day, or list views. The calendar uses FullCalendar 6.1.10, which provides smooth navigation and works on all screen sizes.

Accept Registrations
Let visitors register for your occasions directly through your website. The built-in forms collect attendee information, and you can manage all sign-ups from your admin dashboard.

Track Your Attendees
See who signed up for each occasion, view their details, and export attendee lists when needed. Send confirmation emails automatically when someone registers.

Show Venue Locations
Display venues on an interactive map using OpenStreetMap. No API key required – it works right out of the box.

Build Excitement with Countdown Timers
Add countdown timers to your pages so visitors know exactly when the occasion starts.

Available Shortcodes

  • [EM id="123"] – Display a single event (replace 123 with event ID)
  • [EM-LIST] – Show all events in a card layout
  • [EM-CALENDAR] – Display the interactive event calendar
  • [EM] – Legacy support (shows event list)

Free Version Features

The free version includes everything you need to run basic occasions:

  • Unlimited Events – Create as many events as you want
  • Interactive Calendar – Month, week, day, and list views
  • Event Registration – Accept free registrations on your site
  • Attendee Management – Track registrations and attendee details
  • Email Confirmations – Automatic emails when someone registers
  • OpenStreetMap Integration – Show venue locations without an API key
  • Countdown Timers – Display time remaining until occasions start
  • Social Sharing – Let visitors share on social media
  • Gallery Images – Add up to 5 images per listing
  • Speakers – Add up to 3 speakers per occasion
  • Sponsors – Display up to 3 sponsors per listing
  • Schedule Items – Create up to 5 schedule entries
  • Two Layout Styles – Default and Magazine templates
  • Mobile Responsive – Works on phones, tablets, and desktops
  • Organizer Profiles – Showcase organizers with contact info

Pro Version Features

Event Monster Pro removes all limits and adds advanced features:

  • No Limits – Unlimited galleries, speakers, sponsors, and schedules
  • Payment Processing – Accept payments through PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, and Square
  • Ticket Booking – Create different ticket types with varying prices
  • Coupon Codes – Offer discounts with promotional codes
  • Custom Layout Builder – Drag and drop elements to design your pages
  • Email Templates – Customize confirmation emails with your branding
  • SMTP Support – Reliable email delivery through your mail server
  • Priority Support – Direct assistance from our team

Works For All Occasions

Event Monster adapts to whatever you organize:

  • Conferences and seminars
  • Workshops and training sessions
  • Webinars and online meetings
  • Concerts and performances
  • Community gatherings
  • Corporate meetings and functions
  • Fundraisers and charity gatherings
  • School and university functions
  • Religious gatherings
  • Sports tournaments and activities

sections.installation:
Install From Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your admin panel
  2. Search for “Event Monster”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Find Event Monster in your admin menu to start creating events

Manual Installation

  1. Download the ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Select the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate after installation completes

Getting Started

  1. Navigate to Event Monster > Add New Event
  2. Fill in your event details
  3. Add the [EM-CALENDAR] shortcode to any page for the calendar
  4. Use [EM-LIST] to display your event list
sections.faq:
How do I display the event calendar on my website?

Add the shortcode [EM-CALENDAR] to any page or post. The calendar shows all your events with month, week, day, and list view options.

How do I show a list of all my events?

Use the shortcode [EM-LIST] on any page. This displays events in a card-based layout with search and category filtering.

How do I display a single event?

Use [EM id="X"] where X is the event ID. You can find event IDs in the Event Monster > All Events list in your admin.

Can visitors register for my events?

Yes. Each event can have registration enabled. Visitors fill out a form on the event page, and you can view all registrations in your admin dashboard.

Can I accept payments for event tickets?

The free version supports free registrations only. Event Monster Pro includes PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, and Square payment gateways for ticket booking.

Is there a limit on how many events I can create?

No. Both free and pro versions allow unlimited events.

Do I need a Google Maps API key?

No. Event Monster uses OpenStreetMap for location maps, which works without any API key or setup.

Will this work with my theme?

Event Monster is built to work with any properly coded theme. The CSS is scoped to prevent style conflicts.

Can I create recurring events?

Currently, each occasion is created individually. For recurring schedules, you would create separate entries for each occurrence.

Does the plugin support multiple languages?

Yes. Event Monster is translation-ready. You can translate it using any standard translation plugin or add custom translation files.

Can I categorize my events?

Yes. You can create categories and assign entries to them. Visitors can then filter by category.

How do I customize the look of my listings?

The free version includes two layout templates. Event Monster Pro adds a drag-and-drop layout builder for complete customization.

Can I export my attendee list?

Yes. You can export attendee information from the admin dashboard for use in spreadsheets or other applications.

Is my data safe when updating the plugin?

Yes. Updates preserve all your events, settings, and attendee data. We always recommend backing up your site before major updates as a precaution.

Where can I get support?

Visit the support forum for free version questions. Pro users receive priority support through our helpdesk.

Can I import events from another plugin?

Currently, there is no automatic import feature. Events need to be created manually in Event Monster.

Does Event Monster work with WooCommerce?

Event Monster operates independently and does not require WooCommerce. Payment processing in the Pro version uses its own integrated gateways.

Can I add custom fields to the registration form?

The registration form includes standard fields. Custom field support is available in Event Monster Pro.

How do I set up ticket booking for paid events?

Ticket booking with payment processing is available in Event Monster Pro. The Pro version supports multiple ticket types with different prices and integrates with PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, and Square.

Can I send reminder emails to registered attendees?

The free version sends automatic confirmation emails when someone registers. Event Monster Pro includes customizable email templates for sending event reminders and updates.

How does the countdown timer work?

The countdown timer automatically appears on detail pages, showing days, hours, minutes, and seconds until the occasion starts. It updates in real-time.

Can I add multiple speakers and sponsors to an event?

The free version allows up to 3 speakers and 3 sponsors per event. Event Monster Pro removes these limits, allowing unlimited speakers and sponsors.

Is there a way to check in attendees at the event?

QR-based check-in functionality is available in Event Monster Pro, allowing you to scan attendee tickets at the venue.

Can I embed the event calendar in a sidebar widget?

Yes, you can add the calendar shortcode to a text widget in your sidebar. The calendar is responsive and will adjust to the widget width.

How do I change the default calendar view?

You can set the default calendar view (month, week, day, or list) in the Event Monster settings panel.
